description: Supply-chain verdict for up to 50 packages at once: one table row per package (verdict, version to pin, short reason) and the full notice only for the ones that need attention. Call it once with every dependency you plan to add, before writing the manifest, instead of one check per package. Packages already in the project are checked at their installed version when you omit it.

ecosystem.description: Default for every package: npm, pypi, cargo, go, maven, nuget, rubygems or composer.
Overrides the default ecosystem for this package.

version.description: Version you intend to pin or already use; omit to get the version to use.

name: check-packages
title: Check a whole dependency list in one call
